summary.headline: Software Engineer & Data Science Researcher
summary.about: Computer Science student at Minnesota State University working across backend systems, full-stack applications, and machine learning research. I build reliable tools for real users, from inference routing and clinical simulation to codebase exploration.

bullets: Shipped Senate-sync, a TypeScript/Next.js platform used by 500+ users across four internal tools; owned API design, database schema, and GitHub Actions deployment workflows supporting zero-downtime releases.

Implemented JWT authentication and RBAC for five user roles, added optimistic concurrency control to vote writes, and used Pusher WebSockets with an append-only vote ledger to keep updates real-time and auditable.
Built Jest integration tests for critical authentication and voting workflows, catching regressions before production releases.

Built a Python ETL pipeline to collect, clean, and label a clinical image dataset for SLE detection; trained TensorFlow transfer-learning CNNs and reached 91% accuracy after identifying class imbalance through confusion-matrix analysis and applying weighted loss.
Published the resulting research in a peer-reviewed IEEE paper.

Maintained 99.7% service uptime and reduced incident resolution time by 30% through log-driven debugging and upstream configuration fixes that eliminated recurring alerts; maintained a 98% user satisfaction rate.

projects.name: RouteAlpha: Inference Routing Gateway
projects.summary: An inference gateway that routes requests by task type and token budget, with ordered provider fallback and circuit breakers.

caseStudy.problem: Route inference requests according to task requirements and budget while handling provider failures.
caseStudy.role: Designed the gateway and its routing, validation, security, and telemetry behavior.

backend.summary: A FastAPI/PostgreSQL gateway coordinates inference routing and provider resilience.
details: Routes requests by task type and token budget.
Uses ordered provider fallback and circuit breakers to handle provider failures.
Adds Pydantic output validation, rate limiting, prompt-injection screening, and TOTP-based two-factor authentication.

flow: Select a route by task type and token budget.
Call a provider with ordered fallback and circuit-breaker handling.
Validate the output with Pydantic; move telemetry to FastAPI BackgroundTasks.

decisions.title: Telemetry off the request path
decisions.decision: Moved telemetry to FastAPI BackgroundTasks to keep logging off the request path.

projects.name: CodeGuide: Codebase Q&A and Patch Tool
projects.summary: A developer tool for natural-language questions over indexed codebases and reviewable code patches.

caseStudy.problem: Help developers understand indexed codebases and review generated changes before applying them.

frontend.summary: A TypeScript developer tool presents codebase answers and reviewable patches.
details: Answers natural-language questions over indexed codebases.
Requires human approval before applying generated changes.

backend.summary: Model requests are routed through RouteAlpha’s inference API.
details: Connects the developer workflow to the inference gateway.

flow: Ask a natural-language question over an indexed codebase.
Route the model request through RouteAlpha’s inference API.
Generate an answer or a reviewable patch.
Require human approval before applying changes.

decisions.title: Review before applying changes
decisions.decision: Generated code patches require human approval before they are applied.

projects.name: SAFEHR: Simulation EHR
projects.summary: A clinical simulation platform for MNSU Nursing, with graph-based patient data and role-based access across clinical scenarios.

frontend.summary: A Next.js/React application supports nursing students working through clinical simulation scenarios.

backend.summary: Backend APIs and graph-structured patient data models enforce access by role.
details: Represents patient data as a graph structure.
Enforces role-based access across more than 10 scenarios.
Uses a Pytest regression suite to verify a mid-project schema refactor.

decisions.title: Schema migration with regression coverage
decisions.decision: Built a Pytest regression suite around the application schema refactor.

outcomes: Supported role-based clinical simulation across 10+ scenarios.
Shipped the schema migration with zero regressions.
